sentences.en: The bullet penetrated his chest, leaving him in critical condition.
sentences.zh: 子弹穿透了他的胸膛，使他处于危急状态。

sentences.en: He worked for weeks in behalf of the community chest.
sentences.zh: 他在为社区基金会工作了几周。

sentences.en: I am no longer able to handle the chest pain.
sentences.zh: 我再也无法忍受胸部疼痛了。
